ns2:section.sectionText: An advanced practicum in audio recording including studio microphone techniques, classical/concert microphone techniques, recording session management, audio editing, and advanced mixing, production, and mastering techniques. The course will be presented as a practicum with students recording a variety of instruments and ensembles in the studio, in concert venues, and completing mixing projects of recording sessions. Recording outside of class time will be assigned. Restrictions: Music Tech students or permission of the instructor.
